pedal: Boss RT-2 Rotary Ensemble, Mode III Drive, mono input A and stereo outputs A and B
note: Effect on, LED green (hold the RT-2's own pedal if it's red). Mode III, Rise/Fall FAST. Knob 1: Level (the inner knob) at 12:00 — at 7:00 it mutes the pedal, which is what silenced the 2026-11-18 run; the outer ring twice: Drive Knob toggle to BALANCE, ring to 12:00; then toggle to DRIVE, ring to 7:00. Look at Level again after turning the ring. Knob 2: Fast (inner) at 12:00, Slow (outer ring) at 9:00. Give the rotors 10 s. If the take comes out silent, Level is down: set it to 12:00 and press r.

rig.note: Boss RT-2 on its 9 V adapter: the guitar DI dataset. Input from interface out 3; OUTPUT A -> input 2, OUTPUT B -> input 1; INST, AIR off, pad on, gain fully counter-clockwise.
